summary: The sketch origin and its H and V axes now behave like geometry. The axes are drawn as thin, quiet lines through the origin across the whole view, keep their short H and V arrows, and can be hovered and picked anywhere along their length; hover, focus, selection and an inspected relation bring the whole axis up. Geometry lying on an axis keeps its own pick, then grips and profile edges, and the origin wins where the axes cross. In Select, a click selects the origin or an axis on release, and a press that a document change, cancellation, an interaction lock or the window losing focus overtakes does nothing when released, so a drag that starts on one still draws a box or moves a grip or profile; Shift toggles it with other geometry, Escape clears it, and keyboard focus with Enter or Space still works. The selection filter counts the origin as a point and the axes as edges. Boxes select only sketch geometry: a Shift box keeps the selected origin and axes, and a plain box clears them. Coincident now lays a line on an axis by fixing its endpoints' other coordinate at 0, adding only one endpoint when the line is already horizontal or vertical along that axis, also through joined endpoints, or when a fixed point, a fixed coordinate, a coordinate expression that is 0 whatever the parameters are or a linked reference already holds the other end on it, directly or through a joined point; an end that an expression keeps away from the axis blocks the constraint with a note, and keeps the center of an arc or circle on an axis; Concentric centers an arc or circle at the origin by fixing its center at 0, 0. Both work after choosing the tool and from the Constrain menu for a selection that mixes the origin or axes with geometry; the menu offers only constraints the selection expresses exactly. Place and rotate takes the sketch origin as an exact anchor or target. Relation rows and constraint feedback name a relation that fixes a coordinate at 0 as On the X axis, On the Y axis or Fixed at the origin instead of Fix X, Fix Y or Fixed point; the value editor keeps its coordinate name. A coordinate counts as 0 only when it is 0 whatever the parameters are, such as 0, "0" or "2 - 2"; a value that follows a parameter keeps Fix X or Fix Y even while the parameter is 0. Inspecting such a relation, from the list or a diagnostic, highlights its axis or the origin. The grid leaves out its two zero lines, which the axes now draw over. Hovering along an axis reuses the hit tests each pointer move already makes and measures only the profile edges indexed near the pointer, so it adds no full geometry scan to pointer movement.
warning: Potentially breaking for automation that reads human labels: relation rows and the label field of error.details.feedback subjects now read On the X axis, On the Y axis or Fixed at the origin for a fixed coordinate or point at 0, where they previously read Fix Y, Fix X or Fixed point. Labels remain transient and must not be stored as references; relation kinds, IDs and operands are unchanged. Automation that clicks the sketch on an axis in Select now selects that axis on release instead of clearing the selection; a press that drags from an axis still draws a box or moves a grip or profile, and under the Points or Edges selection filter only the origin or only the axes are focusable. Constraints added with the origin or an axis use the existing fixed-axis kind, so older releases open these sketches. WebMCP tools and their arguments are unchanged. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: No CAD schema change: a line on an axis and a curve centered at the origin use the existing fixed-axis relation with value 0. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event or input-version behavior change. Constraint picks with the origin or axes submit through the same prepared, cancellable sketch edits as other constraint picks. WebMCP tools and their arguments are unchanged; only the human label of zero fixed-coordinate relations in feedback subjects changes.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Coincident accepts a line and an axis, and an arc or circle and an axis, Concentric accepts an arc or circle and the origin, selection-first Constrain accepts the origin and axes with geometry, and Place and rotate accepts the origin as anchor or target. The Dimension tool is unchanged.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents open unchanged.
checklist.verification: cadSketchConstraintTool.test.ts checks a line laid on either axis in either order, a level line adding one endpoint, an end already held on the axis by a fixed point, a fixed coordinate, a constant-zero coordinate expression, a joined point or a linked reference adding only the other end, a line level through a joined endpoint, an end an expression keeps off the axis blocked, an arc or circle centered on an axis in either order and from a selection, constant and parameter zero values, repeated and blocked cases, Concentric with the origin, the selection choices for mixed datum selections, and axis picking anywhere along the axes at several zooms. cadSketchDatumConstraintPreparation.test.ts applies a line with a pinned end, a level line, a line joined to a point on the axis, an endpoint whose coordinate expression is 0, a line level through a joined point, and a circle and an arc centered on an axis through the native solver without redundancy. CadSketchCanvas.test.tsx checks Select picks along the whole axes after geometry lying on them, selection on release with drags from an axis or the origin boxing in mouse and trackpad navigation, Escape, a document change, cancellation, an interaction lock and window blur abandoning the press, right-drag pan from an axis, grip and profile drags kept on an axis, the grid gap at its zero lines, the selection filter, that boxes never take the origin or axes, and a position pick placed exactly at the origin. CadSketchCanvasRender.test.tsx checks that axis hover highlights without rendering graph rows again, and counts picker queries per move along an axis: no graph search, at most one grip query and at most one indexed edge query. cadSketchPicking.test.ts checks the indexed edge query against a scan of every edge. cadSketchConstraintFeedback.test.ts and CadSketchRelationsPanel.test.tsx check the new labels and that the value editor keeps Fix Y. CadWorkbench.test.tsx checks tool-first Coincident and Concentric with the axes and origin, selection-first Constrain with the V axis and a line, and Shift and plain boxes with a selected axis. CadSketchPlacementEditor.test.tsx checks the origin as an exact anchor and target. The full Vitest suite (551 files, 6219 tests), lint, ui:check, build and the release check pass. In Chromium, the new e2e cad-sketch-selectable-axes spec boxes a line with a drag that starts on the H axis, selects the H axis away from the origin and constrains a line to it, and cad-sketch-constraints and cad-sketch-placement pass.

publicNotes.summary: The sketch origin and axes select and constrain like geometry.
changes: The H and V axes cross the whole sketch view as thin lines, and you can hover and pick them anywhere along their length.

In Select, click the origin or an axis to select it, Shift-click to add other geometry, and open Constrain to see the constraints that fit. Boxes select only sketch geometry, and a drag that starts on an axis still draws one.
Coincident lays a line on an axis or keeps an arc or circle centered on one, and Concentric centers an arc or circle at the origin.
Place and rotate can use the sketch origin as its anchor or target.
Relations that keep a point on an axis or at the origin are listed as On the X axis, On the Y axis or Fixed at the origin, and inspecting one highlights it.
publicNotes.compatibility: Sketches keep using existing relation kinds, so earlier releases open them. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: No action needed. Automation that reads relation labels should expect On the X axis, On the Y axis or Fixed at the origin for coordinates fixed at 0.
